author: Animalogic
description:
Deep in the lightless depths of the ocean lives a creature that looks like it came straight out of a nightmare, the Black Sea Devil. This bizarre deep-sea anglerfish lurks hundreds to thousands of meters below the surface, where sunlight never reaches and survival depends on some truly terrifying adaptations.

Examining the nature of the beast.

From apex predators to the planet's strangest creatures, Animalogic goes deep into the science, behavior, and biology of the animal kingdom, one species at a time.
